items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions being with Louie Armstrong; the interviewee does not claim any personal interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x:
Yes he did, Syl Austin and all those
other guys got a chance to go over there.

Yeah, a lot of guys were going to Japan
and doing very well. I know of many people going over there.
I was there with Louie Armstrong many years back, and I really
enjoyed that country very much.
Yeah, I love it over there, too.
